base_hashes.description: Exact precondition for every source/destination path: current SHA-256 from file_read, or null only when an added destination must not exist.
base_hashes.title: Base Hashes

dry_run.description: Preflight and report the patch without changing files.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated stable unique key for this logical mutation or command. Reuse only when retrying that exact same request.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

project_id.description: Opaque project ID returned by projects_list; never send a local path.
project_id.title: Project Id

purpose.description: Concise user-facing reason shown in Windows approval and local activity history.
purpose.title: Purpose

scope_path.description: Optional requested absolute Windows directory outside the project, e.g. C:/Temp. Local project policy and Windows approval still apply; not a trust assertion.
scope_path.title: Scope Path
